entries.decision: Decorate only an actual DMS V2.2 XSD INVALID result caused by exact UpdateStatusEnumeration token InstallationSuccessfull, while preserving InstallationSuccessful as the only authoritative executable lexeme.
guards: official DeviceManagementService V2.2 strict profile only
match only exact UpdateStatusEnumeration token InstallationSuccessfull
must not accept, normalize, or register InstallationSuccessfull as an enum alias
must preserve InstallationSuccessful as the authoritative executable V2.2 enum value
must not generalize spelling correction to other enum tokens
